The user wants to arrange a flight on booking number 1234 as soon as possible, and wants to check different options. They want to calculate the business class fare from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_date 2024-10-31, travel_from first airport, travel_to last airport, travel_class business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to compute total payable amount. But what about booking? They want to arrange a flight on booking number 1234. Possibly they want to book a flight for that booking ID. But the user didn't provide card id or access token. We might need to authenticate first. But we don't have credentials. The user didn't provide client_id, client_secret, etc. So we cannot authenticate. But maybe we can just compute cost. The user says "計算從可用列表中的第一個機場到同一列表中的最後一個機場，在 2024 年 10 月的最後一天的商務艙票價。請提供我預估的總應付金額。" So they want estimated total payable amount. That likely includes flight cost plus maybe insurance? But they didn't mention insurance. So just flight cost.

Thus we need to call get_all_airports to get list. Then get_flight_cost. Then output cost. No need to book. But they also want to arrange a flight on booking number 1234. That might require booking. But we can't because we lack auth. Maybe we can ask for credentials. But the instruction: "If you need to do something that requires a tool, you must call the tool." We can call get_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then output. We don't need to call book_flight because we don't have access token. So we just compute cost.

Thus we call get_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then output.
